The combat-class '''Nallastian V-wing''' was a type of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] of [[Nallastia]].

The shuttle was fitted with two bulbous [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and its bridge was only large enough for a pilot and three passengers.
